name: Swimming Jump
body:
You have learned to make tremendous leaps from the water.

Prerequisite(s): A natural swim speed

Benefit: When swimming, you may make a Swim check instead of an Acrobatics check to leap. In addition, you gain a +4 competence bonus to such checks.

Special: You may use this feat to make a charge attack against a foe who is not within the water. The distance from the target to the water must be equal to or less than 5 ft. + the distance leaped. The intent to charge must be declared before the Acrobatics check is made. If the leap falls short of the target, the charge fails, and you still suffer a -2 penalty to your AC until your next turn.
